## Context / Problem

The scheduled **Test Suite (mirror)** leg `sweep (macos, full suite)` (`.github/workflows/test.yml`, non-editable install, full default suite under xdist) fails 6 review-bot lifespan tests on every scheduled run checked (5 runs, 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-03: 41338211499, 41503532529, 41555561498, 41591840011, 41638314556):

- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_starts_and_stops_snapshot_janitor`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_can_opt_into_the_real_reconcile_loop`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py::test_health_endpoint_reports_the_in_flight_count`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py::test_health_endpoint_reports_the_queue_depth`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py::test_health_endpoint_reports_degraded_when_gerrit_auth_is_broken`

Each fails with `AttributeError: 'State' object has no attribute 'config'` — at `src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:214` (`cfg = app.state.config` in `lifespan`) or at the test's own `monkeypatch.setattr(appmod.app.state, "config", ...)`. In run 41591840011 all of them ran on the same xdist worker (`gw2`). The same tests pass in the gating `build-and-test / pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)` and `(ubuntu-latest, py3.13)` cells, and in `sweep (py3.14)`, which is also non-editable.

## Hypotheses (unproven)

- An earlier test on the same worker deletes or replaces `appmod.app.state` / `app.state.config` without restoring it (test-order state leak that only the full-suite distribution exposes).
- The module-level `app.state.config` is set only on one import path, and the macOS full-suite order imports `rebar.review_bot.app` in a way that skips it.

## Next check

Reproduce with the macOS leg's exact selection and worker distribution (or `-p no:randomly` plus the `gw2` test order from the log) and bisect the preceding tests on that worker.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A deterministic local reproduction is recorded on this ticket, with the test that leaves `app.state` without `config`.
- [ ] A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it.
- [ ] On the first scheduled Test Suite (mirror) run on a main containing the fix, `sweep (macos, full suite)` reports 0 failures in `tests/unit/test_review_bot*.py`.

Found while resolving `targeted-northbound-langur` (session a85e3cd3).
